memories.content: The user's timezone is Europe/Paris.
The user prefers responses in French for casual conversation.
The user's primary code editor is VS Code with the Rust Analyzer extension.
The user's primary development machine runs Windows 11.
Elegy is a Rust toolkit for shipping governed local CLI capabilities to AI-agent hosts.
The team decided to require narrowest-check validation before every commit.
The team decided risky work should always happen on a new branch instead of reusing main directly.
To cut a release, run the publish-orchestrator workflow via workflow_dispatch.
Local CI parity is `just ci`, which runs fmt-check, clippy, then test.
The user prefers Conventional Commit messages with a Refs #N trailer.
Elegy is licensed under Apache-2.0.
The Elegy Cargo workspace has more than twenty member crates.
MCP is an optional adapter in Elegy; CLI invocation templates are the default integration contract.
elegy-memory persists memories in a local SQLite database.
elegy-memory's embedding providers are optional and default to none.
The default salience gate archives a candidate when its importance score is below the salience threshold.
elegy-memory applies exponential recency decay using a per-type multiplier.
A past session logged a different regional clock setting for this account, since superseded.
A past session logged a different code-writing tool preference for this account, since superseded.
The user also maintains a small Python data-processing script unrelated to Elegy.
The user takes their coffee black, no sugar.
The team's daily standup is at 9:30 local time.
Pull requests require at least one review from a maintainer before merge.
The office plant on the third floor is a fiddle-leaf fig.
The team retro is scheduled every other Friday afternoon.
The build server's disk usage alert threshold is 85 percent.
The design team uses a shared Figma library for icons.
This memory is deliberately left with a stale embedding to exercise the stale embedding ratio metric.
